item.title: Episode 1: Welcome In — Run AI on Your Own Machine (Free)
item.itunes:author: Anmol
item.description:
The first episode of AI Workflow and Tips Daily. Why this show exists (short version: I spent years saving brilliant AI workflow posts I never had time to implement, and feeling behind because of it), then three finds spread across the ecosystem, a recipe that costs nothing, and two tips you can use today.
## In this episode
- **Fresh Finds** — Ollama's $65M raise and what local-first AI unlocks; Tencent's Hunyuan Hy3, a 295B-parameter open-weight model under Apache 2.0; and the Model Context Protocol going stateless, with GitHub already rebuilding its server around it. - **The Recipe** — a completely private document summarizer running on your own laptop with Ollama. No cloud, no API bill, nothing leaving your machine. - **Two Quick Tips** — fence pasted text in tags and ask for structured output (the simplest prompt-injection guard); and never paste secrets, plus "draft cheap, finalize expensive". - **Do This Today** — install Ollama and run one model. Ten minutes, completely free.
Note: Claude Code, mentioned in this episode, requires a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) or API billing. There is no free tier.
## Sources
- [Ollama raises $65M — TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/popular-open-source-ai-developer-tool-ollama-raises-65m-grows-to-nearly-9m-users/) - [Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 — Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy3) - [MCP 2026-07-28 release candidate — Model Context Protocol blog](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28-release-candidate/) - [GitHub MCP Server supports the next MCP specification — GitHub Changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-23-github-mcp-server-supports-the-next-mcp-specification/) - [Ollama — official site](https://ollama.com) · [Ollama on GitHub](https://github.com/ollama/ollama) - [Claude Code setup and plan requirements — Anthropic docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)
## Built by
This show is made by a solo developer who builds things in his spare time. If any of it is useful to you, these are the projects behind it:
- **Handled** — done-for-you content and AI agent workflows for creators and busy professionals. Get in touch: **handled.anmol@gmail.com** - **Culmen Games** — an indie Android game studio. (Contact email coming soon.)
Both are early-stage and built in the open. Questions, ideas, or just want to say hi? The Handled address above reaches me.
